changelog: Initial community skill publication for the Neura Relay pre-action workflow. Adds one agent-facing skill that teaches refs-only Action Card creation, Relay Decision Receipt interpretation, and developer/runtime-owned execution boundaries for consequential local actions. Complements the existing @neurarelay/openclaw-preflight-adapter@0.1.4 community plugin package.
display_name: Neura Relay Core for OpenClaw-Style Agents
summary: Use when an OpenClaw-style or local autonomous computer-use agent needs a single Neura Relay preflight workflow for messages, file changes, browser submits,...
